target.title: fix(gateway): accept local file URLs for managed images
target.body:
Closes #103538

## What Problem This Solves

Managed outgoing image preparation rejects a valid local `file://` URL even after resolving and authorizing its filesystem path. The unresolved URI text reaches `saveMediaSource`, which accepts local paths or HTTP(S) URLs and therefore tries to open the entire `file://...` string as a filename.

The failure is deterministic and still reproduces on current `main` at `a6bdc8092bf`. The equivalent absolute path already works.

## Why This Change Was Made

The managed-image owner now computes the local filesystem path once and carries that prepared fact through:

- display-name derivation;
- the existing local-root authorization check; and
- managed storage ingestion.

Remote HTTP(S) sources and image data URLs keep their existing paths. Local-root enforcement is unchanged. The returned display block contains only the managed URL and safe basename; the source path, query, and fragment do not escape.

This is the narrowest owner-boundary fix. Expanding `saveMediaSource` to accept another URL scheme would duplicate file-URL policy below the Gateway's existing resolver and risk inconsistent authorization. PR #103696 overlaps this repair, but this branch additionally includes focused path/file-URL parity and query/fragment privacy coverage plus the real storage proof below.

## User Impact

Callers of the Gateway managed outgoing image service can supply an allowed local image as either an absolute path or `file://` URL. The image is copied into managed outgoing storage and represented by a managed display URL instead of failing preparation.

No config, protocol, migration, dependency, or public Plugin SDK surface changes.

## Evidence

### Real managed-storage proof (no Vitest, no mocks)

Environment: macOS 26.5.1, Node 24.14.0. A standalone Node/tsx harness created a real PNG under a temporary allowed local root, added query/fragment metadata to its file URL, called the production `createManagedOutgoingImageBlocks` export, then read the resulting managed record and copied original from disk. All temporary paths are redacted below and cleaned after each run.

**Before — current `main` `a6bdc8092bf`:**

```json
{
  "head": "a6bdc8092bf2f077365a1b71823c5b1c07a09f12",
  "result": "FAIL",
  "input": "file://<redacted>/proof.png?proof_token=<redacted>#<redacted>",
  "error": "ManagedImageAttachmentError: Managed image attachment \"proof.png?proof_token=must-not-leak#must-not-leak\" could not be prepared"
}
```

**After — exact PR head `3fb13ccc5bd`:**

```json
{
  "head": "3fb13ccc5bd4c84efa997dae75dde482c18d407a",
  "result": "PASS",
  "input": "file://<redacted>/proof.png?proof_token=<redacted>#<redacted>",
  "block": {
    "type": "image",
    "alt": "proof.png",
    "urlShape": "/api/chat/media/outgoing/agent%3Amain%3Aproof/<attachment-id>/full"
  },
  "metadataLeaked": false,
  "managedRecordWritten": true,
  "managedOriginalCopied": true,
  "copiedBytes": 68,
  "originalBytesMatch": true
}
```

This is the exact production storage boundary implicated by #103538. A model/provider turn is intentionally not claimed: ordinary agent replies separately stage or reject host-local file URLs before this exported Gateway service receives them.

### Regression and review proof

- Focused regression (three Gateway shards):
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.gateway.config.ts --configLoader runner src/gateway/managed-image-attachments.test.ts -t 'file URLs'`
  - Before: `3 failed`, `123 skipped`.
  - After: `3 passed`, `123 skipped`.
- Coverage includes absolute-path parity and a `file://` URL with query and fragment metadata; it asserts the safe `proof.png`/`dot.png` basename and no source metadata leakage.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` passes after rebasing onto current `main`.
- Fresh full-branch Codex autoreview: no actionable findings; patch correct, confidence 0.88.
- [Secretless fork-PR CI run 29140906075](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29140906075) passed on exact head `3fb13ccc5bd`: production/test types, lint, every Node shard, build artifacts, both QA smoke profiles, contracts, dependency/security guards, and architecture/boundary checks.

AI assistance disclosure: Codex assisted with investigation, implementation, proof, tests, and review. I reviewed and understand every change in this pull request.
